findings.evidence: NativeDialogSession treated any final detection without providerDialog as proof of disappearance, including unsupported/unavailable/failed uncertainty; success requires an explicit confirmed-absent postcondition.

Runtime authorized after detection without requiring a concrete current dialog instance, allowing an undefined-instance grant to match a later dialog; authorization must fail closed when no instance was observed.
Provider-supplied surfaceRef was forwarded into public dialog metadata without validation; it must be validated as the active public reference or omitted.
Worker terminal command order was invalid; root verification passed independently but worker self-report is not acceptance evidence.
